property_summary: For any caller and input arguments, after initialize(...) completes on the correct contract the public nft() equals the _nft parameter passed (the contract stores the provided NFT address); the mutant which assigns nft = msg.sender violates this because nft() will instead equal the caller for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace assignment to nft so initialize sets nft to msg.sender instead of the provided _nft parameter, changing stored nft address.
